description_en: Updates information about a media asset based on the ID of the media asset in Intelligent Media Services (IMS) or the input URL of the media asset
description_zh: 根据IMS mediaId或媒资InputURL，更新一个媒资的媒资信息
kebab_example: aliyun ice update-media-info --media-id 000020b48fb04483915d4f2cd8ac0000 --input-url http://example-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/example.mp4 --business-type video --title defaultTitle --description defaultDescription --category defaultCategory --media-tags updateTags1,updateTags2 --cover-url http://example-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/example.png --user-data userData --append-tags true --cate-id 3048 --reference-id 123-123 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateMediaInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media asset. If this parameter is left empty, you must specify the input URL of the media asset, which has been registered in the IMS content library
parameters.help_zh: 媒资Id，若为空，则必须有已在IMS内容库中注册过的InputURL
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.help_en:
The input URL of the media asset in another service. The URL must be bound to the ID of the media asset in IMS. The URL cannot be modified once registered.

For a media asset from Object Storage Service (OSS), the URL may have one of the following formats:

1. http(s)://example-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/example.mp4

2. oss\://example-bucket/example.mp4. This format indicates that the region in which the OSS bucket of the media asset resides is the same as the region in which OSS is activated
parameters.help_zh:
待注册的媒资在相应系统中的地址，一经注册不可更改，并与IMS的mediaId绑定。

OSS地址，支持两种格式：

http(s)://example-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/example.mp4

oss://example-bucket/example.mp4
此格式默认oss region与服务接入区域一致
parameters.name: input_url

parameters.help_en:
The business type. Valid values:

subtitles

watermark

opening

ending

general
parameters.help_zh:
媒资业务类型。取值范围：

"subtitles" 字幕

"watermark" 水印

"opening" 片头/开场

"ending" 片尾

"general" 通用
parameters.name: business_type

parameters.help_en:
The title.

The value can be up to 128 bytes in length.

The value must be encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh:
标题。

长度不超过128字节。

UTF8编码
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en:
The content description.

The value can be up to 1,024 bytes in length.

The value must be encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh:
内容描述。

长度不超过1024字节。

UTF8编码
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The category.

The value can be up to 64 bytes in length.

The value must be encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh:
分类。
长度不超过64字节。

UTF8编码
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The tags.

Up to 16 tags are supported.

Separate multiple tags with commas (,).

Each tag can be up to 32 bytes in length.

The value must be encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh:
标签。

最多不超过16个标签。

多个用逗号分隔。

单个标签不超过32字节。

UTF8编码
parameters.name: media_tags

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the thumbnail.

The value can be up to 128 bytes in length.

The value must be encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh:
封面地址。

长度不超过128字节。

UTF8编码
parameters.name: cover_url

parameters.help_en: The user data. It can be up to 1,024 bytes in size
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to append tags. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: updates the MediaTags parameter by appending new tags.

false: updates the MediaTags parameter by overwriting existing tags with new tags
parameters.help_zh:
默认为false，取值：
appendTags = true，以追加的模式更新MediaTags字段。
appendTags = false，以覆盖的模式更新MediaTags字段
parameters.name: append_tags

parameters.help_en: The custom ID. The ID can be 6 to 64 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). Make sure that the ID is unique among users
parameters.help_zh: 自定义ID，仅支持小写字母、大写字母、数字、横线、下划线，长度6-64位。需保证用户维度唯一
parameters.name: reference_id

MediaId.description_en: The ID of the media asset in IMS
